run_trial() {  # run_trial <jid> <arm> <task> <type> <kind> <trial> <run_id> <task_yaml> <watchdog_s>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" task="$3" type="$4" kind="$5" trial="$6" rid="$7" tyaml="$8" wds="$9"
  local base="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
  local attempt=0 rd="" st="" prc retry_reason="" first_usd=0 sig override="" pid
  local t0 t1
  mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
  t0="$(date +%s)"
  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    rd="$(fresh_dir "$base")"
    printf '%s\n' "$rd" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.rundir"
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wdkill"
    printf '%s run-ablation: %s attempt %d run_dir %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$attempt" "$rd" >> "$tlog"
    local -a cmd=("$PIPELINE_BIN" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --arm "$arm" --run-dir "$rd" --run-id "$rid" --trial "$trial"
                  --source-tree "$TREE" --suite-file "$SUITE_FILE" --executor "$EXECUTOR" --image "$IMAGE"
                  --docker-bin "$DOCKER_BIN" --max-run-usd "$RUN_CAP")
    # its own process group, so the watchdog can signal the pipeline and everything under it
    if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
    else "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
    fi
    pid=$!
    printf '%s %s %s\n' "$pid" "$(date +%s)" "$wds" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
    prc=0; wait "$pid" || prc=$?
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
    st="$(final_status "$rd")"
    if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" ]]; then
      override=interrupted
      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "watchdog: no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (pipeline exit $prc)"
      break
    fi
    if [[ -z "$st" ]]; then
      override=interrupted
      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "no final pipeline record (pipeline exit $prc)"
      break
    fi
    if [[ "$st" == agent_error ]] && sig="$(is_pipeline_transport_failure "$rd")"; then
      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
        first_usd="$(jq -r '(.spent_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
        retry_reason="transport: ${sig% *} in phase ${sig#* }"
        printf '%s run-ablation: %s %s; retrying once after %ss into a fresh run dir\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$retry_reason" "$RETRY_WAIT" >> "$tlog"
        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
      fi
      override=transport_error
    fi
    break
  done
  post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "$tyaml" "$attempt" "$retry_reason" "$st" "$override" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$tlog"
  t1="$(date +%s)"
  jq -n --arg rid "$rid" --arg rd "$rd" --argjson att "$attempt" --arg rr "$retry_reason" --arg first "$first_usd" \
    --arg pst "${st:-}" --arg ov "$PR_OVERRIDE" --arg te "$PR_TE" --arg ter "$PR_TE_REASON" --argjson drift "$PR_DRIFT" \
    --argjson grc "$PR_GRC" --argjson rrc "$PR_RRC" --argjson secs "$(( t1 - t0 ))" --argjson extra "$PR_EXTRA" \
    '{run_id: $rid, run_dir: $rd, attempts: $att, retry_reason: (if $rr == "" then null else $rr end),
      first_attempt_usd: ($first | tonumber? // 0), pipeline_status: $pst, override: $ov, took_effect: $te,
      took_effect_reason: $ter, drift: $drift, grade_rc: $grc, row_rc: $rrc, seconds: $secs,
      extra_models: $extra}' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp"
  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result"
}

# --- parent: collect a finished job ---------------------------------------------------
append_and_validate() {  # append_and_validate <row-file> <run_id> → 0 ok; 1 invalid (ROWS_INVALID set)
  local rowf="$1" rid="$2" vout vrc=0 n
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$ROWS"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    { flock -x 9; cat "$rowf" >> "$ROWS"; vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || vrc=$?; } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  else
    cat "$rowf" >> "$ROWS"; vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || vrc=$?
  fi
  n="$(grep -cF "\"run_id\":\"$rid\"" "$ROWS" || true)"
  if [[ $vrc -ne 0 ]]; then
    ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --arg e "$(printf '%s' "$vout" | tail -1)" '{run_id: $r, error: $e}')"; return 1
  fi
  if [[ "$n" -ne 1 ]]; then
    ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --argjson n "$n" '{run_id: $r, error: "run_id rowed \($n) times"}')"; return 1
  fi
  return 0
}

# apply_flags <arm> <run_id> <took_effect> <reason> <drift> — a took-effect FAIL pauses the
# arm (DEC-0418); the first drift stops the batch (DEC-0407)
apply_flags() {
  if [[ "$3" == fail ]] && ! is_paused "$1"; then
    PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$1" --arg why "$2: $4" '. + {($a): $why}' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
    log "PAUSED arm $1: $4 (no further trial of $1 launches until --resume --clear-arm $1)"
  fi
  if [[ "$5" != null && "$DRIFT_JSON" == null ]]; then
    DRIFT_JSON="$5"; STOP=drift
    log "DRIFT $2: $5; no further trial launches; the batch fails when the running trials end (DEC-0407)"
  fi
  return 0
}
# record_extra <run_id> <extra models json> — the run's extra models replace its earlier entry
record_extra() {
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$1" --argjson e "$2" \
    'if ($e | type) == "object" and ($e | length) > 0 then .[$r] = ($e | map_values(.output_tokens // 0)) else del(.[$r]) end' <<<"$EXTRA_RUNS_JSON")"
}

# outage_tick <run_id> <row status, empty without a row> — the breaker (DEC-0554): consecutive
# collected transport_error trials (collection order, any arm) trip it at $OUTAGE_BREAKER (0 off)
outage_tick() {
  if [[ "$2" == transport_error ]]; then OUTAGE_RUN=$((OUTAGE_RUN + 1)); else OUTAGE_RUN=0; fi
  if [[ "$OUTAGE_BREAKER" -gt 0 && $OUTAGE_RUN -ge $OUTAGE_BREAKER && "$OUTAGE_JSON" == null && -z "$STOP" ]]; then
    STOP=outage
    OUTAGE_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson n "$OUTAGE_RUN" --arg r "$1" \
      '{at: $at, consecutive: $n, last_run_id: $r,
        message: "partial (outage breaker): \($n) consecutive transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back"}')"
    log "OUTAGE breaker: $OUTAGE_RUN consecutive transport_error trials (last $1); no further trial launches (DEC-0554)"
  fi
  return 0
}

collect() {  # collect <jid> <plan-index>
  local jid="$1" k="$2" arm="${PL_ARM[$2]}" rid="${PL_RUN[$2]}" kind="${PL_KIND[$2]}" res="$JOBS_DIR/$1.result"
  if [[ ! -f "$res" ]]; then
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $rid (the trial job ended without a result; see $BATCH_DIR/$arm/${PL_TASK[$k]}-t${PL_TRIAL[$k]}.log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    outage_tick "$rid" ""
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*; write_status; return 0
  fi
  local first att rr te ter drift
  first="$(jq -r '.first_attempt_usd' "$res")" att="$(jq -r '.attempts' "$res")" rr="$(jq -r '.retry_reason // ""' "$res")"
  te="$(jq -r '.took_effect' "$res")" ter="$(jq -r '.took_effect_reason' "$res")" drift="$(jq -c '.drift' "$res")"
  record_extra "$rid" "$(jq -c '.extra_models // {}' "$res")"
  if [[ "$att" -ge 2 ]]; then
    RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg why "$rr" --arg u "$first" '. + [{run_id: $r, reason: $why, first_attempt_usd: ($u | tonumber)}]' <<<"$RETRIES_JSON")"
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$first")"; LEDGER_USD="$(fadd "$LEDGER_USD" "$first")"
  fi
  local st="" cost deg pass
  if [[ -s "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
    IFS=$'\t' read -r st cost deg pass < <(jq -r '[.status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring),
        ((.hidden_test_pass_rate // .defect_catch_rate // "n/a") | tostring)] | @tsv' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")
    if is_rerun "$rid"; then
      # DEC-0553: the new row replaces the old one in place; the old row's reported cost moves to the ledger
      if replace_row_try "$rid" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"; then
        local from ocost
        from="$(jq -r --arg r "$rid" '.[$r].status' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")" ocost="$(jq -r --arg r "$rid" '.[$r].cost' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        LEDGER_USD="$(fadd "$LEDGER_USD" "$ocost")"
        RERUN_LIST="${RERUN_LIST/$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'/$'\n'}"
        RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "$from" --arg t "$st" --arg c "$ocost" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
          '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, old_cost_usd: ($c | tonumber), at: $at}]' <<<"$RERUN_JSON")"
        log "rerun $rid: $from → $st (row replaced in place)"
      else
        ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --arg e "$REPLACE_ERR" '{run_id: $r, error: ("rerun replacement: " + $e)}')"
        log "ROWS INVALID after $rid: $(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID")"; STOP=invalid
      fi
    elif append_and_validate "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$rid"; then :; else
      log "ROWS INVALID after $rid: $(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID")"; STOP=invalid
    fi
    DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
    account_row "$arm" "$kind" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    log "done $rid $st pass=$pass USD $cost $(( $(jq -r '.seconds' "$res") / 60 ))m attempts $att${rr:+ ($rr)}"
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $rid: no row written (ablation-row.sh exit $(jq -r '.row_rc' "$res"); see the trial log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
  fi
  outage_tick "$rid" "$st"
  apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$te" "$ter" "$drift"
  rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
  write_status
}

PIDS=() PJOB=() PIDX=()
watchdog_tick() {
  local j f pid start wds now rd t0
  now="$(date +%s)"
  for j in ${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}; do
    f="$JOBS_DIR/$j.pgid"; [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    read -r pid start wds < "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
    [[ -n "$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE" ]] && wds="$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE"
    [[ $(( now - start )) -gt $wds ]] || continue
    rd="$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$j.rundir" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [[ -z "$(final_status "$rd")" ]] || continue
    if [[ ! -f "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$now" > "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd"
      log "watchdog: $j has no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (twice its phase-sum timeout); SIGTERM to process group $pid"
      kill -TERM -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    elif [[ ! -f "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wdkill" ]]; then
      read -r t0 < "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd" || t0="$now"
      if [[ $(( now - t0 )) -ge $WATCHDOG_GRACE ]]; then
        : > "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wdkill"
        log "watchdog: $j still running ${WATCHDOG_GRACE}s after SIGTERM; SIGKILL to process group $pid"
        kill -KILL -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
  done
  return 0
}
reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
  local i
  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PIDX[$i]}"
        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PIDX[i]'
        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PIDX=("${PIDX[@]+"${PIDX[@]}"}")
        break
      fi
    done
    watchdog_tick
    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep "$POLL_S"
  done
  return 0
}

on_signal() {
  SIGNALLED=true
  log "interrupted: the driver received a signal; running trials are signalled and will be rerun by --resume"
  STATE=partial; write_status
  exit 1
}

finish() {  # finish <state> <exit> <message>
  STATE="$1"; write_status; log "$3"
  local line
  line="$("$SPEND_BIN" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
  {
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "${line:-spend.sh printed nothing}"
    printf '%s batch %s spend USD %s (rows %s + first attempts %s; %s assumed cap charge(s)); max %s\n' \
      "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$BATCH" "$SPENT" "$ROWS_USD" "$LEDGER_USD" "$ASSUMED_CAP" "${MAX_USD:-none}"
  } >> "$BATCH_DIR/spend.txt"
  echo "run-ablation: $3"
  echo "batch: $BATCH_DIR"
  exit "$2"
}

# --- --rerow: the post-run chain again over a rowed run dir, the row replaced in place ---
# replace_row_try <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; 1 with REPLACE_ERR set and the rows file
# untouched (the old row stays). replace_row is the --rerow form: it dies instead
replace_row_try() {
  local rid="$1" newf="$2" tmp="$ROWS.rerow.$$" rc=0 vout="" perr
  REPLACE_ERR=""
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$tmp"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  {
    command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && flock -x 9
    perr="$(python3 -I - "$ROWS" "$tmp" "$BATCH" "$rid" "$newf" 2>&1 <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows, tmp, batch, rid, newf = sys.argv[1:6]
new = open(newf, encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
out, n = [], 0
with open(rows, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    for line in fh:
        try: o = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError: o = None
        if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("batch") == batch and o.get("run_id") == rid:
            n += 1; out.append(new + "\n")
        else:
            out.append(line if line.endswith("\n") else line + "\n")
if n != 1:
    print("run_id %s has %d rows" % (rid, n), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: fh.writelines(out)
PY
)" || rc=$?
    if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then
      vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || rc=$?
      if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then mv "$tmp" "$ROWS"; else REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$vout" | tail -1)"; fi
    else
      REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$perr" | tail -1)"
    fi
  } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  rm -f "$tmp"
  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || { REPLACE_ERR="${REPLACE_ERR:-exit $rc}"; return 1; }
  return 0
}
replace_row() {  # replace_row <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; dies (rows file untouched) otherwise
  replace_row_try "$1" "$2" && return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$REPLACE_ERR" >&2
  die "rerow $1: the replacement did not validate or the row moved ($REPLACE_ERR); $ROWS unchanged"
}
rerow_all() {
  local n k rid arm task trial rd tlog newst
  for n in "${!RR_K[@]}"; do
    k="${RR_K[$n]}" rid="${PL_RUN[${RR_K[$n]}]}" arm="${PL_ARM[${RR_K[$n]}]}" task="${PL_TASK[${RR_K[$n]}]}"
    trial="${PL_TRIAL[${RR_K[$n]}]}" rd="${RR_RD[$n]}" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
    printf '%s run-ablation: rerow %s run_dir %s (was %s)\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$rd" "${RR_FROM[$n]}" >> "$tlog"
    rm -f "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${RR_ATT[$n]}" "${RR_REASON[$n]}" "$(final_status "$rd")" "" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" "$tlog"
    [[ -s "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" ]] || die "rerow $rid: ablation-row.sh wrote no row (exit $PR_RRC; see $tlog); $ROWS unchanged"
    replace_row "$rid" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    newst="$(jq -r '.status' "$WORK/rerow-$n.row")"
    record_extra "$rid" "$PR_EXTRA"
    apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$PR_TE" "$PR_TE_REASON" "$PR_DRIFT"
    REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "${RR_FROM[$n]}" --arg t "$newst" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, at: $at}]' <<<"$REROWED_JSON")"
    jq --argjson r "$REROWED_JSON" '.rerowed = $r' "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json" > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" \
      && mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
    log "rerow $rid: ${RR_FROM[$n]} → $newst"
  done
  return 0
}

# --- --resume reconciliation: rows on disk are the truth (after --rerow) --------
if [[ "$RESUME" == true ]]; then
  ST_PATH="$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
  STARTED="$(jq -r '.started // empty' "$ST_PATH")"; [[ -n "$STARTED" ]] || STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c '.cuts // []' "$ST_PATH")"; RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c '.retries // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c '.paused_arms // {}' "$ST_PATH")"
  LEDGER_USD="$(jq -r '.spend.ledger_usd // 0' "$ST_PATH")"; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$LEDGER_USD")"
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c '.extra_models_by_run // {} | if type == "object" then . else {} end' "$ST_PATH")"
  DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c '.drift_cleared // []' "$ST_PATH")"; REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerowed // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerun // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c '.outage_history // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  if [[ "$(jq -c '.outage // null' "$ST_PATH")" != null ]]; then
    OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson o "$(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH")" '. + [$o]' <<<"$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON")"
    log "resume: the outage breaker record $(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH") is cleared (kept under outage_history)"
  fi
  if [[ "$CLEAR_PENDING" != null ]]; then
    DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CLEAR_PENDING" '. + [$c]' <<<"$DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON")"
    log "resume: --clear-drift $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$CLEAR_PENDING") (previous drift re-read under the current rule: none)"
  fi
  for a in ${CLEAR_ARMS[@]+"${CLEAR_ARMS[@]}"}; do
    if is_paused "$a"; then PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$a" 'del(.[$a])' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"; log "resume: --clear-arm $a (paused arm released)"
    else log "resume: --clear-arm $a: the arm is not paused"; fi
  done
  # rerows first, so spend and per_arm below come from the final rows
  rerow_all
  if [[ -f "$ROWS" ]]; then
    dup="$(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b) | .run_id' "$ROWS" | sort | uniq -d | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
    [[ -z "$dup" ]] || refuse "resume: $ROWS holds run_id(s) twice: $dup"
    want_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"}; do want_ids="$want_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    rerow_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do rerow_ids="$rerow_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    want_st=" ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"} "
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r rid st cost deg; do
      k=-1
      for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
      [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || continue
      if [[ "$want_ids" == *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]] \
         || { [[ "$want_st" == *" $st "* ]] && [[ "$rerow_ids" != *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]]; }; then
        # DEC-0553: out of the done set, so the plan launches it again; no counter, no assumed charge;
        # its reported cost (real spend) stays in spent
        [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
        RERUN_LIST="$RERUN_LIST$rid"$'\n'; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
        RERUN_OLD="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg s "$st" --arg c "$cost" '.[$r] = {status: $s, cost: ($c | tonumber)}' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        continue
      fi
      DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
      i="$(arm_index "${PL_ARM[$k]}")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
      account_row "${PL_ARM[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    done < <(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b)
               | [.run_id, .status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring)] | @tsv' "$ROWS")
  fi
  n_rerun="$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | grep -c . || true)"
  [[ ${#RERUN_STATUSES[@]} -eq 0 && ${#RERUN_IDS[@]} -eq 0 ]] \
    || log "resume: $n_rerun trial(s) flagged for a rerun (--rerun ${RERUN_IDS[*]+"${RERUN_IDS[*]}"} --rerun-status ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"}; DEC-0553)"
  log "resume: batch $BATCH, $LAUNCHED of $PLAN_N trials rowed, spent $SPENT, paused $(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
fi

# --- dispatch --------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "start batch=$BATCH smoke=$SMOKE source=${SRC_FULL:0:12} executor=$EXECUTOR image=$IMAGE cli=$CLI_VERSION concurrency=$CONCURRENCY rows=$ROWS"
log "$PLAN_LINE"
[[ "$RESUME" == true ]] || jq -r '.refused[] | "refused: \(.arm) \(.task_id) \(.type) (task_types \(.task_types | tojson)) DEC-0405"' "$WORK/plan.json" \
  | while IFS= read -r l; do log "$l"; done
write_status
trap on_signal INT TERM HUP

n=0
for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do
  rid="${PL_RUN[$k]}" a="${PL_ARM[$k]}"
  is_done "$rid" && continue
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  if [[ -n "$MAX_USD" ]] && ! budget_gate "$a|${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$((k + 1))" "${PL_KIND[$k]}"; then
    CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CUT_JSON" '. + [$c]' <<<"$CUTS_JSON")"; STOP=cut; write_status; break
  fi
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "${PL_TASK[$k]}" "${PL_TYPE[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "${PL_TRIAL[$k]}" "$rid" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${PL_WD[$k]}" &
  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PIDX+=("$k")
  i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
  log "launch $rid ($a ${PL_TASK[$k]} ${PL_TYPE[$k]} t${PL_TRIAL[$k]})"
done
reap 1

# --- the batch's end state ---------------------------------------------------------------
total_completed=0 left=0 excluded=0
for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_completed=$(( total_completed + ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} )); excluded=$(( excluded + ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} )); done
for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do is_done "${PL_RUN[$k]}" || left=$((left + 1)); done
paused_n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
if [[ "$ROWS_INVALID" != null ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: the rows file is invalid after $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID") ($(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID"))"
elif [[ "$DRIFT_JSON" != null ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: drift in $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON") ($(jq -r '.field' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"): expected $(jq -c '.expected' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"), got $(jq -c '.got' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"))"
elif [[ "$OUTAGE_JSON" != null ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "$(jq -r '.message' <<<"$OUTAGE_JSON")"
elif [[ "$CUTS_JSON" != '[]' && $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial (cut max_usd): $((PLAN_N - left)) of $PLAN_N rowed, spent $SPENT"
elif [[ $total_completed -eq 0 ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: no trial completed ($((PLAN_N - left)) rowed, $left without a row)"
elif [[ $paused_n -gt 0 && $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  if [[ "$paused_n" -ge "${#ARMS[@]}" ]]; then
    finish failed 3 "failed: every arm is paused by took-effect ($(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")); $left trials left"
  fi
  finish partial 1 "partial: paused arm(s) $(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON") left $left trials; --resume --clear-arm <id> after reading the cause"
elif [[ $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial: $left of $PLAN_N trials have no row (see run.log)"
elif [[ $excluded -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial: all $PLAN_N trials rowed, $excluded excluded (transport, infrastructure, interrupted or contaminated)"
else
  finish complete 0 "complete: $PLAN_N trials rowed, spent $SPENT"
fi

tool_use_result.stdout:
fi
  local -a r=("$ROW_BIN" --run-dir "$rd" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --manifest "$MAN_PATH" --attempts "$attempts" --out "$row_out")
  [[ -n "$rr" ]] && r+=(--retry-reason "$rr")
  [[ -n "$PR_OVERRIDE" ]] && r+=(--status "$PR_OVERRIDE")
  "${r[@]}" >> "$plog" 2>&1 || PR_RRC=$?
  return 0
}

run_trial() {  # run_trial <jid> <arm> <task> <type> <kind> <trial> <run_id> <task_yaml> <watchdog_s>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" task="$3" type="$4" kind="$5" trial="$6" rid="$7" tyaml="$8" wds="$9"
  local base="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
  local attempt=0 rd="" st="" prc retry_reason="" first_usd=0 sig override="" pid
  local t0 t1
  mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
  t0="$(date +%s)"
  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    rd="$(fresh_dir "$base")"
    printf '%s\n' "$rd" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.rundir"
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wdkill"
    printf '%s run-ablation: %s attempt %d run_dir %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$attempt" "$rd" >> "$tlog"
    local -a cmd=("$PIPELINE_BIN" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --arm "$arm" --run-dir "$rd" --run-id "$rid" --trial "$trial"
                  --source-tree "$TREE" --suite-file "$SUITE_FILE" --executor "$EXECUTOR" --image "$IMAGE"
                  --docker-bin "$DOCKER_BIN" --max-run-usd "$RUN_CAP")
    # its own process group, so the watchdog can signal the pipeline and everything under it
    if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
    else "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
    fi
    pid=$!
    printf '%s %s %s\n' "$pid" "$(date +%s)" "$wds" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
    prc=0; wait "$pid" || prc=$?
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
    st="$(final_status "$rd")"
    if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" ]]; then
      override=interrupted
      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "watchdog: no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (pipeline exit $prc)"
      break
    fi
    if [[ -z "$st" ]]; then
      override=interrupted
      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "no final pipeline record (pipeline exit $prc)"
      break
    fi
    if [[ "$st" == agent_error ]] && sig="$(is_pipeline_transport_failure "$rd")"; then
      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
        first_usd="$(jq -r '(.spent_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
        retry_reason="transport: ${sig% *} in phase ${sig#* }"
        printf '%s run-ablation: %s %s; retrying once after %ss into a fresh run dir\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$retry_reason" "$RETRY_WAIT" >> "$tlog"
        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
      fi
      override=transport_error
    fi
    break
  done
  post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "$tyaml" "$attempt" "$retry_reason" "$st" "$override" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$tlog"
  t1="$(date +%s)"
  jq -n --arg rid "$rid" --arg rd "$rd" --argjson att "$attempt" --arg rr "$retry_reason" --arg first "$first_usd" \
    --arg pst "${st:-}" --arg ov "$PR_OVERRIDE" --arg te "$PR_TE" --arg ter "$PR_TE_REASON" --argjson drift "$PR_DRIFT" \
    --argjson grc "$PR_GRC" --argjson rrc "$PR_RRC" --argjson secs "$(( t1 - t0 ))" --argjson extra "$PR_EXTRA" \
    '{run_id: $rid, run_dir: $rd, attempts: $att, retry_reason: (if $rr == "" then null else $rr end),
      first_attempt_usd: ($first | tonumber? // 0), pipeline_status: $pst, override: $ov, took_effect: $te,
      took_effect_reason: $ter, drift: $drift, grade_rc: $grc, row_rc: $rrc, seconds: $secs,
      extra_models: $extra}' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp"
  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result"
}

# --- parent: collect a finished job ---------------------------------------------------
append_and_validate() {  # append_and_validate <row-file> <run_id> → 0 ok; 1 invalid (ROWS_INVALID set)
  local rowf="$1" rid="$2" vout vrc=0 n
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$ROWS"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    { flock -x 9; cat "$rowf" >> "$ROWS"; vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || vrc=$?; } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  else
    cat "$rowf" >> "$ROWS"; vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || vrc=$?
  fi
  n="$(grep -cF "\"run_id\":\"$rid\"" "$ROWS" || true)"
  if [[ $vrc -ne 0 ]]; then
    ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --arg e "$(printf '%s' "$vout" | tail -1)" '{run_id: $r, error: $e}')"; return 1
  fi
  if [[ "$n" -ne 1 ]]; then
    ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --argjson n "$n" '{run_id: $r, error: "run_id rowed \($n) times"}')"; return 1
  fi
  return 0
}

# apply_flags <arm> <run_id> <took_effect> <reason> <drift> — a took-effect FAIL pauses the
# arm (DEC-0418); the first drift stops the batch (DEC-0407)
apply_flags() {
  if [[ "$3" == fail ]] && ! is_paused "$1"; then
    PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$1" --arg why "$2: $4" '. + {($a): $why}' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
    log "PAUSED arm $1: $4 (no further trial of $1 launches until --resume --clear-arm $1)"
  fi
  if [[ "$5" != null && "$DRIFT_JSON" == null ]]; then
    DRIFT_JSON="$5"; STOP=drift
    log "DRIFT $2: $5; no further trial launches; the batch fails when the running trials end (DEC-0407)"
  fi
  return 0
}
# record_extra <run_id> <extra models json> — the run's extra models replace its earlier entry
record_extra() {
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$1" --argjson e "$2" \
    'if ($e | type) == "object" and ($e | length) > 0 then .[$r] = ($e | map_values(.output_tokens // 0)) else del(.[$r]) end' <<<"$EXTRA_RUNS_JSON")"
}

# outage_tick <run_id> <row status, empty without a row> — the breaker (DEC-0554): consecutive
# collected transport_error trials (collection order, any arm) trip it at $OUTAGE_BREAKER (0 off)
outage_tick() {
  if [[ "$2" == transport_error ]]; then OUTAGE_RUN=$((OUTAGE_RUN + 1)); else OUTAGE_RUN=0; fi
  if [[ "$OUTAGE_BREAKER" -gt 0 && $OUTAGE_RUN -ge $OUTAGE_BREAKER && "$OUTAGE_JSON" == null && -z "$STOP" ]]; then
    STOP=outage
    OUTAGE_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson n "$OUTAGE_RUN" --arg r "$1" \
      '{at: $at, consecutive: $n, last_run_id: $r,
        message: "partial (outage breaker): \($n) consecutive transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back"}')"
    log "OUTAGE breaker: $OUTAGE_RUN consecutive transport_error trials (last $1); no further trial launches (DEC-0554)"
  fi
  return 0
}

collect() {  # collect <jid> <plan-index>
  local jid="$1" k="$2" arm="${PL_ARM[$2]}" rid="${PL_RUN[$2]}" kind="${PL_KIND[$2]}" res="$JOBS_DIR/$1.result"
  if [[ ! -f "$res" ]]; then
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $rid (the trial job ended without a result; see $BATCH_DIR/$arm/${PL_TASK[$k]}-t${PL_TRIAL[$k]}.log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    outage_tick "$rid" ""
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*; write_status; return 0
  fi
  local first att rr te ter drift
  first="$(jq -r '.first_attempt_usd' "$res")" att="$(jq -r '.attempts' "$res")" rr="$(jq -r '.retry_reason // ""' "$res")"
  te="$(jq -r '.took_effect' "$res")" ter="$(jq -r '.took_effect_reason' "$res")" drift="$(jq -c '.drift' "$res")"
  record_extra "$rid" "$(jq -c '.extra_models // {}' "$res")"
  if [[ "$att" -ge 2 ]]; then
    RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg why "$rr" --arg u "$first" '. + [{run_id: $r, reason: $why, first_attempt_usd: ($u | tonumber)}]' <<<"$RETRIES_JSON")"
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$first")"; LEDGER_USD="$(fadd "$LEDGER_USD" "$first")"
  fi
  local st="" cost deg pass
  if [[ -s "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
    IFS=$'\t' read -r st cost deg pass < <(jq -r '[.status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring),
        ((.hidden_test_pass_rate // .defect_catch_rate // "n/a") | tostring)] | @tsv' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")
    if is_rerun "$rid"; then
      # DEC-0553: the new row replaces the old one in place; the old row's reported cost moves to the ledger
      if replace_row_try "$rid" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"; then
        local from ocost
        from="$(jq -r --arg r "$rid" '.[$r].status' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")" ocost="$(jq -r --arg r "$rid" '.[$r].cost' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        LEDGER_USD="$(fadd "$LEDGER_USD" "$ocost")"
        RERUN_LIST="${RERUN_LIST/$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'/$'\n'}"
        RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "$from" --arg t "$st" --arg c "$ocost" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
          '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, old_cost_usd: ($c | tonumber), at: $at}]' <<<"$RERUN_JSON")"
        log "rerun $rid: $from → $st (row replaced in place)"
      else
        ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --arg e "$REPLACE_ERR" '{run_id: $r, error: ("rerun replacement: " + $e)}')"
        log "ROWS INVALID after $rid: $(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID")"; STOP=invalid
      fi
    elif append_and_validate "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$rid"; then :; else
      log "ROWS INVALID after $rid: $(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID")"; STOP=invalid
    fi
    DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
    account_row "$arm" "$kind" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    log "done $rid $st pass=$pass USD $cost $(( $(jq -r '.seconds' "$res") / 60 ))m attempts $att${rr:+ ($rr)}"
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $rid: no row written (ablation-row.sh exit $(jq -r '.row_rc' "$res"); see the trial log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
  fi
  outage_tick "$rid" "$st"
  apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$te" "$ter" "$drift"
  rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
  write_status
}

PIDS=() PJOB=() PIDX=()
watchdog_tick() {
  local j f pid start wds now rd t0
  now="$(date +%s)"
  for j in ${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}; do
    f="$JOBS_DIR/$j.pgid"; [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    read -r pid start wds < "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
    [[ -n "$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE" ]] && wds="$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE"
    [[ $(( now - start )) -gt $wds ]] || continue
    rd="$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$j.rundir" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [[ -z "$(final_status "$rd")" ]] || continue
    if [[ ! -f "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$now" > "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd"
      log "watchdog: $j has no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (twice its phase-sum timeout); SIGTERM to process group $pid"
      kill -TERM -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    elif [[ ! -f "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wdkill" ]]; then
      read -r t0 < "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd" || t0="$now"
      if [[ $(( now - t0 )) -ge $WATCHDOG_GRACE ]]; then
        : > "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wdkill"
        log "watchdog: $j still running ${WATCHDOG_GRACE}s after SIGTERM; SIGKILL to process group $pid"
        kill -KILL -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
  done
  return 0
}
reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
  local i
  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PIDX[$i]}"
        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PIDX[i]'
        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PIDX=("${PIDX[@]+"${PIDX[@]}"}")
        break
      fi
    done
    watchdog_tick
    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep "$POLL_S"
  done
  return 0
}

on_signal() {
  SIGNALLED=true
  log "interrupted: the driver received a signal; running trials are signalled and will be rerun by --resume"
  STATE=partial; write_status
  exit 1
}

finish() {  # finish <state> <exit> <message>
  STATE="$1"; write_status; log "$3"
  local line
  line="$("$SPEND_BIN" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
  {
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "${line:-spend.sh printed nothing}"
    printf '%s batch %s spend USD %s (rows %s + first attempts %s; %s assumed cap charge(s)); max %s\n' \
      "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$BATCH" "$SPENT" "$ROWS_USD" "$LEDGER_USD" "$ASSUMED_CAP" "${MAX_USD:-none}"
  } >> "$BATCH_DIR/spend.txt"
  echo "run-ablation: $3"
  echo "batch: $BATCH_DIR"
  exit "$2"
}

# --- --rerow: the post-run chain again over a rowed run dir, the row replaced in place ---
# replace_row_try <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; 1 with REPLACE_ERR set and the rows file
# untouched (the old row stays). replace_row is the --rerow form: it dies instead
replace_row_try() {
  local rid="$1" newf="$2" tmp="$ROWS.rerow.$$" rc=0 vout="" perr
  REPLACE_ERR=""
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$tmp"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  {
    command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && flock -x 9
    perr="$(python3 -I - "$ROWS" "$tmp" "$BATCH" "$rid" "$newf" 2>&1 <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows, tmp, batch, rid, newf = sys.argv[1:6]
new = open(newf, encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
out, n = [], 0
with open(rows, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    for line in fh:
        try: o = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError: o = None
        if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("batch") == batch and o.get("run_id") == rid:
            n += 1; out.append(new + "\n")
        else:
            out.append(line if line.endswith("\n") else line + "\n")
if n != 1:
    print("run_id %s has %d rows" % (rid, n), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: fh.writelines(out)
PY
)" || rc=$?
    if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then
      vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || rc=$?
      if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then mv "$tmp" "$ROWS"; else REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$vout" | tail -1)"; fi
    else
      REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$perr" | tail -1)"
    fi
  } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  rm -f "$tmp"
  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || { REPLACE_ERR="${REPLACE_ERR:-exit $rc}"; return 1; }
  return 0
}
replace_row() {  # replace_row <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; dies (rows file untouched) otherwise
  replace_row_try "$1" "$2" && return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$REPLACE_ERR" >&2
  die "rerow $1: the replacement did not validate or the row moved ($REPLACE_ERR); $ROWS unchanged"
}
rerow_all() {
  local n k rid arm task trial rd tlog newst
  for n in "${!RR_K[@]}"; do
    k="${RR_K[$n]}" rid="${PL_RUN[${RR_K[$n]}]}" arm="${PL_ARM[${RR_K[$n]}]}" task="${PL_TASK[${RR_K[$n]}]}"
    trial="${PL_TRIAL[${RR_K[$n]}]}" rd="${RR_RD[$n]}" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
    printf '%s run-ablation: rerow %s run_dir %s (was %s)\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$rd" "${RR_FROM[$n]}" >> "$tlog"
    rm -f "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${RR_ATT[$n]}" "${RR_REASON[$n]}" "$(final_status "$rd")" "" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" "$tlog"
    [[ -s "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" ]] || die "rerow $rid: ablation-row.sh wrote no row (exit $PR_RRC; see $tlog); $ROWS unchanged"
    replace_row "$rid" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    newst="$(jq -r '.status' "$WORK/rerow-$n.row")"
    record_extra "$rid" "$PR_EXTRA"
    apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$PR_TE" "$PR_TE_REASON" "$PR_DRIFT"
    REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "${RR_FROM[$n]}" --arg t "$newst" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, at: $at}]' <<<"$REROWED_JSON")"
    jq --argjson r "$REROWED_JSON" '.rerowed = $r' "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json" > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" \
      && mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
    log "rerow $rid: ${RR_FROM[$n]} → $newst"
  done
  return 0
}

# --- --resume reconciliation: rows on disk are the truth (after --rerow) --------
if [[ "$RESUME" == true ]]; then
  ST_PATH="$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
  STARTED="$(jq -r '.started // empty' "$ST_PATH")"; [[ -n "$STARTED" ]] || STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c '.cuts // []' "$ST_PATH")"; RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c '.retries // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c '.paused_arms // {}' "$ST_PATH")"
  LEDGER_USD="$(jq -r '.spend.ledger_usd // 0' "$ST_PATH")"; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$LEDGER_USD")"
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c '.extra_models_by_run // {} | if type == "object" then . else {} end' "$ST_PATH")"
  DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c '.drift_cleared // []' "$ST_PATH")"; REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerowed // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerun // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c '.outage_history // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  if [[ "$(jq -c '.outage // null' "$ST_PATH")" != null ]]; then
    OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson o "$(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH")" '. + [$o]' <<<"$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON")"
    log "resume: the outage breaker record $(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH") is cleared (kept under outage_history)"
  fi
  if [[ "$CLEAR_PENDING" != null ]]; then
    DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CLEAR_PENDING" '. + [$c]' <<<"$DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON")"
    log "resume: --clear-drift $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$CLEAR_PENDING") (previous drift re-read under the current rule: none)"
  fi
  for a in ${CLEAR_ARMS[@]+"${CLEAR_ARMS[@]}"}; do
    if is_paused "$a"; then PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$a" 'del(.[$a])' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"; log "resume: --clear-arm $a (paused arm released)"
    else log "resume: --clear-arm $a: the arm is not paused"; fi
  done
  # rerows first, so spend and per_arm below come from the final rows
  rerow_all
  if [[ -f "$ROWS" ]]; then
    dup="$(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b) | .run_id' "$ROWS" | sort | uniq -d | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
    [[ -z "$dup" ]] || refuse "resume: $ROWS holds run_id(s) twice: $dup"
    want_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"}; do want_ids="$want_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    rerow_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do rerow_ids="$rerow_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    want_st=" ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"} "
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r rid st cost deg; do
      k=-1
      for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
      [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || continue
      if [[ "$want_ids" == *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]] \
         || { [[ "$want_st" == *" $st "* ]] && [[ "$rerow_ids" != *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]]; }; then
        # DEC-0553: out of the done set, so the plan launches it again; no counter, no assumed charge;
        # its reported cost (real spend) stays in spent
        [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
        RERUN_LIST="$RERUN_LIST$rid"$'\n'; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
        RERUN_OLD="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg s "$st" --arg c "$cost" '.[$r] = {status: $s, cost: ($c | tonumber)}' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        continue
      fi
      DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
      i="$(arm_index "${PL_ARM[$k]}")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
      account_row "${PL_ARM[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    done < <(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b)
               | [.run_id, .status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring)] | @tsv' "$ROWS")
  fi
  n_rerun="$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | grep -c . || true)"
  [[ ${#RERUN_STATUSES[@]} -eq 0 && ${#RERUN_IDS[@]} -eq 0 ]] \
    || log "resume: $n_rerun trial(s) flagged for a rerun (--rerun ${RERUN_IDS[*]+"${RERUN_IDS[*]}"} --rerun-status ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"}; DEC-0553)"
  log "resume: batch $BATCH, $LAUNCHED of $PLAN_N trials rowed, spent $SPENT, paused $(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
fi

# --- dispatch --------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "start batch=$BATCH smoke=$SMOKE source=${SRC_FULL:0:12} executor=$EXECUTOR image=$IMAGE cli=$CLI_VERSION concurrency=$CONCURRENCY rows=$ROWS"
log "$PLAN_LINE"
[[ "$RESUME" == true ]] || jq -r '.refused[] | "refused: \(.arm) \(.task_id) \(.type) (task_types \(.task_types | tojson)) DEC-0405"' "$WORK/plan.json" \
  | while IFS= read -r l; do log "$l"; done
write_status
trap on_signal INT TERM HUP

n=0
for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do
  rid="${PL_RUN[$k]}" a="${PL_ARM[$k]}"
  is_done "$rid" && continue
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  if [[ -n "$MAX_USD" ]] && ! budget_gate "$a|${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$((k + 1))" "${PL_KIND[$k]}"; then
    CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CUT_JSON" '. + [$c]' <<<"$CUTS_JSON")"; STOP=cut; write_status; break
  fi
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "${PL_TASK[$k]}" "${PL_TYPE[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "${PL_TRIAL[$k]}" "$rid" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${PL_WD[$k]}" &
  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PIDX+=("$k")
  i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
  log "launch $rid ($a ${PL_TASK[$k]} ${PL_TYPE[$k]} t${PL_TRIAL[$k]})"
done
reap 1

# --- the batch's end state ---------------------------------------------------------------
total_completed=0 left=0 excluded=0
for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_completed=$(( total_completed + ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} )); excluded=$(( excluded + ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} )); done
for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do is_done "${PL_RUN[$k]}" || left=$((left + 1)); done
paused_n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
if [[ "$ROWS_INVALID" != null ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: the rows file is invalid after $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID") ($(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID"))"
elif [[ "$DRIFT_JSON" != null ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: drift in $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON") ($(jq -r '.field' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"): expected $(jq -c '.expected' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"), got $(jq -c '.got' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"))"
elif [[ "$OUTAGE_JSON" != null ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "$(jq -r '.message' <<<"$OUTAGE_JSON")"
elif [[ "$CUTS_JSON" != '[]' && $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial (cut max_usd): $((PLAN_N - left)) of $PLAN_N rowed, spent $SPENT"
elif [[ $total_completed -eq 0 ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: no trial completed ($((PLAN_N - left)) rowed, $left without a row)"
elif [[ $paused_n -gt 0 && $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  if [[ "$paused_n" -ge "${#ARMS[@]}" ]]; then
    finish failed 3 "failed: every arm is paused by took-effect ($(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")); $left trials left"
  fi
  finish partial 1 "partial: paused arm(s) $(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON") left $left trials; --resume --clear-arm <id> after reading the cause"
elif [[ $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial: $left of $PLAN_N trials have no row (see run.log)"
elif [[ $excluded -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial: all $PLAN_N trials rowed, $excluded excluded (transport, infrastructure, interrupted or contaminated)"
else
  finish complete 0 "complete: $PLAN_N trials rowed, spent $SPENT"
fi

3:# adversarial-review.sh — Adversarial cross-model dissent for code review/audit
4:# =============================================================================
5:# Version: 1.0.0
6:# Part of: Adversarial Flatline Protocol (#224)
7:#
8:# Usage:
9:#   adversarial-review.sh --type <review|audit> --sprint-id <id> --diff-file <path> [options]
10:#
11:# Options:
12:#   --type <review|audit>     Dissent type (required)
13:#   --sprint-id <id>          Sprint identifier (required)
14:#   --diff-file <path>        Path to git diff file (required)
15:#   --diff-range <base>...<head>
16:#                             Instead of --diff-file: the script runs `git diff` on the range itself (ref names only)
17:#   --context-file <path>     Reviewer findings (review only; omit for audit independence)
18:#   --model <model>           Dissenter model (default: from config or gpt-5.3-codex)
19:#   --budget <cents>          Max cost in cents (default: from config or 150)
20:#                             cycle-131 FR-4: flatline_protocol.<code_review|security_audit>.budget_scale: fixed | diff
21:#                             (default fixed — an absent key is the shipped gate, envelope unchanged) and budget_cents_max
22:#                             (default 600). diff: the gate's budget is min(max(<this budget>, ceil(estimate × 1.2)),
23:#                             budget_cents_max), estimate = the pre-dispatch estimate over the planned voices; above it
24:#                             the run refuses (exit 4, status budget_exceeded, reason budget). A malformed scale or maximum
25:#                             is said and fixed applies. With the key written the envelope's metadata carries
26:#                             budget_scale, budget_cents_effective, budget_cents_max.
27:#
28:# Findings (cycle-131 FR-4): each finding may carry anchor_line / anchor_line_end (the head-file line, or range, it
29:# sits on) beside the symbol anchor; kept only as whole numbers 1..10,000,000 (end ≥ start), else dropped silently.
30:#   --timeout <seconds>       API timeout (default: from config or 60)
31:#   --dry-run                 Assemble context without calling API
32:#   --json                    Output as JSON (default)
33:#   --record-fallback <status> --reason <text> [--since <ISO-8601 UTC>]
34:#                             Write the failed-run record instead of a review (no --diff-file): status `failed` (the
35:#                             run aborted — never over a standing envelope, unless `--since <the run's start>` shows it
36:#                             older: the previous round's, moved aside) or a pre-lock refusal (`workdir_unavailable`,
37:#                             `nothing_to_review`, `budget_exceeded`, `diff_range_failed` — the previous envelope and
38:#                             sidecars go aside as `.prev`, never one `--since` shows newer); under the run lock, so a live run is refused (`refused_concurrent_run`, exit 2)

42:#   1 - Configuration error (disabled, missing config)

# Adversarial Cross-Model Review — Phase 2.5 mechanics

Referenced from `reviewing-code/SKILL.md` Phase 2.5. Runs when
`flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled: true` in `.loa.config.yaml`.

**Objective**: Invoke a cross-model dissenter to catch reviewer blind spots before the final decision.

**Steps**:
1. Invoke adversarial review as the bare call the allowlist grants (`--diff-range`: the script runs the `git diff` itself):
   ```bash
   .claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh --type review --sprint-id <sprint_id> \
     --diff-range main...HEAD --context-file <concerns file> --json
   ```
2. Read `grimoires/loa/a2a/{sprint_id}/adversarial-review.json` (Read tool) and parse its findings:
   - If `findings` is empty: continue to Phase 3 — after triaging any rejected payloads (`rejected_summary` or sidecar rows) under `## Rejected dissent payloads`, which is mandatory either way
   - If the invocation failed: record it (below) before Phase 3
   - If BLOCKING findings exist: incorporate into Phase 4 decision (forces CHANGES_REQUIRED)
   - If ADVISORY findings only: append as "Cross-Model Observations" section in feedback

**Failure must produce a record.** The `adversarial-review-gate.sh` hook checks this file before any COMPLETED marker is written (when `flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled`): it must parse and carry `metadata.type` and `metadata.model` — a `--record-fallback` record names no model, so it never opens the gate: re-run the dissent before the audit completes the sprint (or the operator sets `LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false`, noted in sprint notes). When `adversarial-review.json` is ABSENT after the script exits — an aborted run leaves none: at start the script moves the previous round's envelope and sidecars aside as `.prev` and never restores them — record the failure with the script itself (a call this skill's allowlist holds; never a hand-written file):

```bash
.claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh --type review --sprint-id <sprint_id> --record-fallback failed --reason "<what happened>"
```

before proceeding. Branch on the `status` line the script prints on stdout, never on exit 2 alone (exit 2 with no status line is a usage error, or a standing envelope that stderr names):

- **An envelope stands after a run that took the run lock** — it is the script's own: triage it; never overwrite it.
- **`failed`** (no envelope: the run aborted) — the call above writes `{"findings": [], "metadata": {"status": "failed", "reason": "<what happened>", "rejected_summary": [], "rejected_sidecars": []}}` under the per-(sprint, gate) run lock. It never writes over an envelope that stands (exit 2), unless the run died before its lock with no status on stdout: what stands is then the previous round's — add `--since <the time on the run's "run started" stderr line>` and an envelope older than that goes aside as `.prev`.
- **`refused_concurrent_run`** (another run — a detached or backgrounded one — holds the run lock; nothing recorded, nothing moved; a `--record-fallback` made meanwhile is refused the same way) — wait until the holding run has exited: an envelope that then stands with a `metadata.timestamp` after your refusal is that run's: triage it as this round's dissent only when its `metadata.scope` is what you asked for (the same `diff_range` and `diff_oids` as your refusal's own `metadata.scope` — the commits, not just the ref names — and `run_tag` null: a chunk driver's tagged run reviewed one chunk); otherwise, or when none stands, run again.
- **`workdir_unavailable`, `nothing_to_review`, `budget_exceeded`, `diff_range_failed`** (the range's `git diff` failed — e.g. a base ref a shallow clone lacks; `workdir_unavailable` with `metadata.path` is a previous round's file that could not be moved aside — make the a2a directory writable; written BEFORE the run lock, or with it released; non-zero exit, stdout only; nothing moved aside, so any envelope at the path is the PREVIOUS run's and never this round's evidence) — record it: `--record-fallback <the status> --reason "<its stdout line>" --since <the run started time>` (it never displaces an envelope written after that) moves that envelope and its `adversarial-rejected-review*.jsonl` sidecars aside as `<name>.prev` (as a run does at start) before it writes, so `verdict-derive.sh` judges this round's record, not the last round's.

A record names what it moved aside (`metadata.displaced`: status, timestamp, findings, rejected); `verdict-derive.sh` warns when that held findings. `verdict-derive.sh` never scans `.prev` files (they are the previous round's evidence, already triaged in that round's feedback) and reports `.prev` files with NO envelope as a `dissent_aborted` violation, which a fallback record clears; `rejected_sidecars: []` does not silence a canonical `adversarial-rejected-review*.jsonl` beside it — that is this run's own partial work, counted whether listed or not: triage its rows under `## Rejected dissent payloads`.

Do NOT silently skip — the gate hook has no way to distinguish "not attempted" from "attempted and failed", and the distinction matters for audit trail.

**Parameter Derivation**:
| Script Parameter | SKILL Derivation |
|-----------------|-----------------|
| `--sprint-id` | From SKILL invocation args, resolved via ledger |
| `--diff-range` | `main...HEAD` (the script runs `git diff`) |
| `--context-file` | Reviewer's Phase 2 concern notes, written (Write tool) to `grimoires/loa/a2a/{sprint_id}/reviewer-concerns.md` |
| `--model` | From `flatline_protocol.code_review.model` config |
| `--budget` | From `flatline_protocol.code_review.budget_cents` config |
| `--timeout` | From `flatline_protocol.code_review.timeout_seconds` config |

**Output**: Findings written to `grimoires/loa/a2a/{sprint_id}/adversarial-review.json`

   - If `findings` is empty: continue to Phase 3 — after triaging any rejected payloads (`rejected_summary` or sidecar rows) under `## Rejected dissent payloads`, which is mandatory either way
   - If the invocation failed: record it (below) before Phase 3

   - If ADVISORY findings only: append as "Cross-Model Observations" section in feedback

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# lib/arms-common.sh — helpers shared by the two batch runners (cycle-130 Task 3.2)
#
# Sourced (never executed) by evals/harness/run-arms.sh (cycle-129 recall arms) and
# evals/harness/run-ablation.sh (cycle-130 ablation batches), each by the literal
# relative path ./lib/arms-common.sh after `pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR"` (eval.yml trust
# boundary: no variable on a source line, no .claude/ code). Extracted from
# run-arms.sh without behaviour change; evals/tests/run-arms.bats is the golden check.
#
# Functions:
#   usd_ok <v>                 0 when <v> is an amount in USD (1-6 digits, up to 4 decimals)
#   fadd <a> <b>               a + b, printed %.10g (awk)
#   json_array <v>…            the arguments as a compact JSON string array
#   is_transport_failure <ws>  run-arms layout: <ws>/.eval/{executor.json,agent-output.json,
#                              agent-stderr.log}; 0 when the executor failed for a transport
#                              reason (timeout exit 124/137/143, no result event, API error
#                              status, or a CLI transport message on stderr)
#   is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
#                              pipeline-run.sh layout: 0 when meta/pipeline.json says
#                              agent_error AND the failing phase (the last executed record
#                              with a non-zero exit, else the last executed record) shows a
#                              provider/transport signature: its transcripts/stderr-<label>.log
#                              matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE, or its events-<label>.jsonl holds a
#                              result event with a non-empty api_error_status, or an is_error
#                              result (the CLI's own error, never the agent's text) whose text
#                              starts "API Error" or matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE (a usage or
#                              session limit). Assistant messages are never read. A phase timeout is the
#                              model's own account (DEC-0417) and is never transport here.
#                              Prints the signature source (stderr | api_error_status |
#                              api_error_result) and the phase label on success.
#   est_record <key> <pool> <cost>   add one completed trial's cost to the key's and the
#                              pool's means (est_next's inputs)
#   est_next <key> [<pool>]    the next trial's expected cost: the key's mean, else the
#                              pool's mean (default pool "all"), else `est_hint <key>`
#                              (default: $COST_HINT; a runner may redefine est_hint)
#   spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
#                              charge one finished trial to SPENT: a trial that ended
#                              without status completed and without a reported cost is
#                              charged RUN_CAP (ASSUMED_CAP+1, logged); else its cost.
#                              Sets CHARGED_COST to the reported cost it accepted (0 for an
#                              assumed charge); call it directly, never in $( ), or SPENT
#                              is lost with the subshell
#   budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
#                              0 launch; 1 cut (CUT_JSON set). Waits (reap) while only the
#                              in-flight reservation (${#PIDS[@]} × RUN_CAP) blocks the launch
#
# Globals read: RUN_CAP, MAX_USD, COST_HINT, LAUNCHED, PIDS (array); written: SPENT,
# ASSUMED_CAP, CHARGED_COST, CUT_JSON, EST_KEYS/EST_SUM/EST_N, POOL_KEYS/POOL_SUM/POOL_N (parallel
# arrays: bash 3.2 has no associative arrays). The caller defines log and reap.
# =============================================================================

usd_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$ ]]; }
fadd() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", a + b }'; }
json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }

# The CLI's transport messages (audit r1 DISS-C-005: matched on the CLI's stderr only,
# never on the agent's own output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry
# by mentioning a network error).
ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE='rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]'

is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
  grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  return 1
}

is_pipeline_transport_failure() {  # is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
  local rd="$1" pipe="$1/meta/pipeline.json" label
  [[ "$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$pipe" 2>/dev/null)" == "agent_error" ]] || return 1
  label="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true)] as $r
                  | ([$r[] | select((.exit // 0) != 0)] | last // ($r | last) // {}) | .label // ""' \
           "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,15}$ ]] || return 1
  if grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$rd/transcripts/stderr-$label.log" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'stderr %s\n' "$label"; return 0
  fi
  local ev="$rd/transcripts/events-$label.jsonl" sig=""
  if [[ -f "$ev" ]]; then
    sig="$(jq -R -r --arg re "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "result")
                    | if ((.api_error_status // "") | tostring) != "" then "api_error_status"
                      elif .is_error == true and ((.result // "") | type) == "string"
                           and ((.result // "") | test("^API Error|" + $re; "i")) then "api_error_result"
                      else empty end' "$ev" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then printf '%s %s\n' "$sig" "$label"; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

# --- est_next inputs (completed trials only; assumed charges never enter) ---------
EST_KEYS=() EST_SUM=() EST_N=() POOL_KEYS=() POOL_SUM=() POOL_N=()
_est_find() {  # _est_find <EST|POOL> <key> → index or -1
  local i
  if [[ "$1" == EST ]]; then
    for i in ${EST_KEYS[@]+"${!EST_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${EST_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  else
    for i in ${POOL_KEYS[@]+"${!POOL_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${POOL_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  fi
  echo -1
}
est_record() {  # est_record <key> <pool> <cost>
  local i
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#EST_KEYS[@]}; EST_KEYS[$i]="$1"; EST_SUM[$i]=0; EST_N[$i]=0; fi
  EST_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${EST_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; EST_N[$i]=$(( ${EST_N[$i]} + 1 ))
  i="$(_est_find POOL "$2")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#POOL_KEYS[@]}; POOL_KEYS[$i]="$2"; POOL_SUM[$i]=0; POOL_N[$i]=0; fi
  POOL_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${POOL_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; POOL_N[$i]=$(( ${POOL_N[$i]} + 1 ))
}
est_hint() { printf '%s' "$COST_HINT"; }
est_next() {  # est_next <key> [<pool>]
  local i p
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"; p="$(_est_find POOL "${2:-all}")"
  if [[ "$i" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${EST_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${EST_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${EST_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  elif [[ "$p" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${POOL_N[$p]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${POOL_SUM[$p]}" -v n="${POOL_N[$p]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  else est_hint "$1"; fi
}

spend_charge() {  # spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
  local st="$1" cost="$2" what="$3"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
  if [[ "$st" != "completed" ]] && awk -v c="$cost" 'BEGIN { exit !(c + 0 == 0) }'; then
    # audit MEDIUM-A2: a failed trial that reports no cost is charged the run cap
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "assumed cap: $what ended ${st:-without a status} with no reported cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    CHARGED_COST=0
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    CHARGED_COST="$cost"
  fi
}

budget_gate() {  # budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
  local key="$1" at="$2" pool="${3:-all}" est inflight reserved
  while true; do
    est="$(est_next "$key" "$pool")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}
    reserved="$(awk -v k="$inflight" -v c="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", k * c }')"
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + e > m) }'; then
      CUT_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg s "$SPENT" --arg r "$reserved" --arg m "$MAX_USD" --arg e "$est" \
        --argjson launched "$LAUNCHED" --argjson at "$at" \
        '{reason: "max_usd", spent: ($s | tonumber), in_flight_reserved: ($r | tonumber), max: ($m | tonumber),
          est_next: ($e | tonumber), trials_launched: $launched, at_trial: $at}')"
      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"
      return 1
    fi
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v r="$reserved" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + r + e > m) }'; then
      reap "$inflight"; continue
    fi
    return 0
  done
}

  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"; p="$(_est_find POOL "${2:-all}")"
  if [[ "$i" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${EST_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${EST_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${EST_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  elif [[ "$p" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${POOL_N[$p]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${POOL_SUM[$p]}" -v n="${POOL_N[$p]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  else est_hint "$1"; fi
}

spend_charge() {  # spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
  local st="$1" cost="$2" what="$3"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
  if [[ "$st" != "completed" ]] && awk -v c="$cost" 'BEGIN { exit !(c + 0 == 0) }'; then
    # audit MEDIUM-A2: a failed trial that reports no cost is charged the run cap
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "assumed cap: $what ended ${st:-without a status} with no reported cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    CHARGED_COST=0
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    CHARGED_COST="$cost"
  fi
}

budget_gate() {  # budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
  local key="$1" at="$2" pool="${3:-all}" est inflight reserved
  while true; do
    est="$(est_next "$key" "$pool")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}
    reserved="$(awk -v k="$inflight" -v c="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", k * c }')"
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + e > m) }'; then
      CUT_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg s "$SPENT" --arg r "$reserved" --arg m "$MAX_USD" --arg e "$est" \
        --argjson launched "$LAUNCHED" --argjson at "$at" \
        '{reason: "max_usd", spent: ($s | tonumber), in_flight_reserved: ($r | tonumber), max: ($m | tonumber),
          est_next: ($e | tonumber), trials_launched: $launched, at_trial: $at}')"
      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"
      return 1
    fi
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v r="$reserved" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + r + e > m) }'; then
      reap "$inflight"; continue
    fi
    return 0
  done
}

def write_out(path, text):
    if os.path.islink(path):
        raise Fail(f"refusing to write through the symlink {path}")
    parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if not os.path.isdir(parent):
        raise Fail(f"the directory of {path} does not exist")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {message}\n")
        sys.exit(2)


def main(argv):
    ap = Parser(prog="ablation-report.py", description="cycle-130 ablation report (see the header)")
    ap.add_argument("--runs", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--manifests", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--suite", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--json", dest="json_out")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261015)
    ap.add_argument("--resamples", type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=float)
    ap.add_argument("--exclude-degraded", choices=("true", "false"), default="true")
    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--cuts")
    ap.add_argument("--not-run")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    args.exclude_degraded = args.exclude_degraded == "true"
    try:
        text, data, decidable = build(args)
        write_out(args.out, text)
        if args.json_out:
            write_out(args.json_out, json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    except Fail as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {e}\n")
        return 2
    if args.partial and not decidable:
        sys.stderr.write("ablation-report.py: --partial: no comparison has a valid pair yet (report written)\n")
        return 1
    print(f"ablation-report.py: wrote {args.out}" + (f" and {args.json_out}" if args.json_out else ""))
    return 0

                f"{t} {u3(v)}" for t, v in m["false_positives_per_task"].items()))

        tin_s = "n/a" if tin is None else f"{tin:.0f}"
        tout_s = "n/a" if tout is None else f"{tout:.0f}"
        L(f"- cost per task USD {u3(m['cost_per_task'])}, per run USD {u3(m['cost_per_run'])}; wall-clock per run "
          f"{wall_s}; tokens in/out per run {tin_s} / {tout_s}")
        L("")

    L("## Exclusions")
    L("")
    if main.excluded:
        L("| run_id | arm | task | trial | status | reason |")
        L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
        for e in sorted(main.excluded, key=lambda e: (e["arm"], e["task_id"], e["trial"], e["run_id"])):
            L(f"| `{e['run_id']}` | `{e['arm']}` | {e['task_id']} | {e['trial']} | {e['status']} | {md_cell(e['reason'])} |")

        L("No row was excluded.")
    L("")
    caps = [c["valid"] for (_, _), trials in sorted(main.cells.items()) for _, c in sorted(trials.items())
            if c["valid"] is not None and c["valid"]["status"] == "cap_failure"]
    L("### Cap failures (scored 0 on every applicable primary; the sensitivity figure excludes them)")
    L("")
    for r in caps:
        L(f"- `{r['run_id']}` (`{r['arm']}`, {r['task_id']} t{r['trial']}, cap_phase {r.get('cap_phase') or 'n/a'}, "
          f"USD {float(r.get('cost_usd') or 0):.2f})")

    L("")
    L("### Rows listed, never decided")
    L("")
    if main.listed or dups:
        for r, why in main.listed:

        for dd in dups:
            L(f"- `{dd['run_id']}` at {dd['dropped']}: duplicate run_id, the row at {dd['kept']} is used")
    else:
        L("None.")
    L("")

    L("## Cuts")
    L("")
    pw = [d for d in decisions if d["state"] == "inconclusive_by_power" and d["arm"] not in cuts]
    if not cuts and not pw:
        L("- none recorded")
    for a in sorted(cuts):
        c = cuts[a]
        L(f"- `{a}`: {DISPLAY[c['state']]} — reason: {c['reason']}; figure: {c['figure']} ({c['source']})")
    for d in pw:

    L(f"- cut ladder (suite): {'; '.join(suite.get('cut_ladder') or []) or 'n/a'}")
    L("")

    L(f"## Sensitivity figure: {SENS_LABEL}")
    L("")
    L("| component | arm | n pairs | pass-rate Δ [90 % CI] | catch-rate Δ [90 % CI] (defects) | cost Δ % | "
      "wall-clock Δ % | excluded share | predicate outcome (not used) |")
    L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for d in sens_rows:
        cp = {p["metric"]: p for p in d["comparisons"]}
        npairs = ", ".join(f"{p['n']} {p['unit']}" for p in d["comparisons"])
        catch = interval(cp.get(CATCH)) if CATCH in cp else "n/a (build-only)"
        share = "n/a" if d["excluded_share"] is None else f"{d['excluded_share']:.3f}"
        L(f"| {d['arm_label']} | `{d['arm']}` | {npairs} | {interval(cp.get(PASS))} | {catch} | {pct(d['c'])} | "
          f"{pct(d['w'])} | {share} | {d['predicate_label']} |")
    L("")

    L("## Rows per cell")
    L("")
    for d in decisions:
        for p in d["comparisons"]:
            if not p["pairs"]:
                continue
            L(f"### {d['arm_label']} `{d['arm']}` — {p['metric']}")
            L("")
            L("| task | arm value | a1_full value | diff | arm rows | a1_full rows |")
            L("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
            for x in p["pairs"]:
                L(f"| {x['task_id']} | {u3(x['arm_value'])} | {u3(x['control_value'])} | {f3(x['diff'])} | "
                  f"{', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['arm_runs']))} | "
                  f"{', '.join('`' + s + '`' for s in collapse(x['control_runs']))} |")
            L("")
    for title, comps in (("H1 a1_full − a0_bare", h1_comps), ("A4 a4_no_gates − a1_full", [a4] if a4 else [])):
        for p in comps:

            L("| task | diff | arm rows | control rows |")
            L("|---|---|---|---|")

      "(pairwise); a task with no valid cell in either arm leaves the pair and is listed.")

      f"replacement from random.Random({seed}) (one generator per interval), linear interpolation between "
      f"order statistics, [lo, hi] at the {(1 - args.level) / 2:.2f} and {1 - (1 - args.level) / 2:.2f} quantiles; "

      "inconclusive outcome whose excluded-share clause matched.")
    L("")

    data = {
        "schema_version": REPORT_SCHEMA, "generator": f"ablation-report.py {VERSION}", "partial": bool(args.partial),
        "suite": {"path": args.suite, "name": suite.get("name"), "suite_version": suite.get("suite_version")},
        "provenance": {"source_commits": distinct("source_commit"), "suite_manifest_sha256": shas,
                       "suite_versions": distinct("suite_version"), "image_digests": distinct("image_digest"),
                       "batches": [{"batch": b, "smoke": m.get("smoke") is True, "shuffle_seed": m.get("shuffle_seed"),

        "bootstrap": {"resamples": args.resamples, "level": args.level, "seed": seed},
        "exclude_degraded": bool(args.exclude_degraded),
        "decisions": [{"arm": d["arm"], "arm_label": d["arm_label"], "label": d["label"], "state": d["state"], "rule": d["rule"],
                       "figure": d["figure"], "predicate_state": d["predicate_state"],
                       "predicate_rule": d["predicate_rule"], "primaries": d["primaries"],
                       "c": j6(d["c"]), "w": j6(d["w"]), "cost_tasks": d["cost_tasks"],
                       "excluded_share": j6(d["excluded_share"]), "excluded_cells": d["excluded_cells"],
                       "cells_seen": d["cells_seen"], "mde_flag": d["mde_flag"], "decidable": d["decidable"],
                       "comparisons": [comp_json(p) for p in d["comparisons"]]} for d in decisions],
        "absent": [{"arm": a["id"], "label": a.get("label"), "state": "component_absent",
                    "evidence": a.get("evidence")} for a in absent],
        "h1": {"line": h1_line, "established": h1_ok, "rule": rules.get("h1"),

        "a4": {"line": a4_line, "holds": a4_ok, "rule": rules.get("a4_sensitivity"),
               "comparison": comp_json(a4) if a4 else None},
        "expected_false_positives": {"components": k, "per_direction": j6(efp), "line": efp_line},
        "arms": {a: {kk: (j6(v) if isinstance(v, float) else
                          ({t: j6(x) for t, x in v.items()} if kk == "false_positives_per_task" else v))
                     for kk, v in metrics[a].items()} for a in metrics},
        "exclusions": sorted(main.excluded, key=lambda e: (e["arm"], e["task_id"], e["trial"], e["run_id"])),
        "listed": [{"run_id": r["run_id"], "arm": r["arm"], "task_id": r["task_id"], "status": r["status"],
                    "reason": why} for r, why in main.listed],
        "duplicates": dups,
        "cap_failures": [r["run_id"] for r in caps],
        "cuts": [dict(arm=a, **cuts[a]) for a in sorted(cuts)],
        "sensitivity": {"label": SENS_LABEL,
                        "rows": [{"arm": d["arm"], "predicate_state": d["predicate_state"], "c": j6(d["c"]),
                                  "w": j6(d["w"]), "excluded_share": j6(d["excluded_share"]),
                                  "comparisons": [comp_json(p) for p in d["comparisons"]]} for d in sens_rows]},
    }
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n", data, decidable


def write_out(path, text):
    if os.path.islink(path):
        raise Fail(f"refusing to write through the symlink {path}")
    parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if not os.path.isdir(parent):
        raise Fail(f"the directory of {path} does not exist")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {message}\n")
        sys.exit(2)


def main(argv):
    ap = Parser(prog="ablation-report.py", description="cycle-130 ablation report (see the header)")
    ap.add_argument("--runs", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--manifests", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--suite", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--json", dest="json_out")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261015)
    ap.add_argument("--resamples", type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=float)
    ap.add_argument("--exclude-degraded", choices=("true", "false"), default="true")
    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--cuts")
    ap.add_argument("--not-run")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    args.exclude_degraded = args.exclude_degraded == "true"
    try:
        text, data, decidable = build(args)
        write_out(args.out, text)
        if args.json_out:
            write_out(args.json_out, json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    except Fail as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {e}\n")
        return 2
    if args.partial and not decidable:
        sys.stderr.write("ablation-report.py: --partial: no comparison has a valid pair yet (report written)\n")
        return 1
    print(f"ablation-report.py: wrote {args.out}" + (f" and {args.json_out}" if args.json_out else ""))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

setup_file() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  export REPO_ROOT
  export REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/ablation-report.py"
  export SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
  export FX="$BATS_FILE_TMPDIR/fx"
  mkdir -p "$FX"
  python3 -I "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py" "$FX"
  for s in main boundary exclusions; do

      --out "$FX/$s/report.md" --json "$FX/$s/report.json" >/dev/null
  done
}

setup() {
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
}

teardown() {
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

dec() {  # dec <scenario> <arm> <jq path under the decision>

}

cmp_of() {  # cmp_of <scenario> <arm> <metric> <jq path under the comparison>
  jq -r --arg a "$2" --arg m "$3" ".decisions[] | select(.arm == \$a) | .comparisons[] | select(.metric == \$m) | $4" "$FX/$1/report.json"

report() {  # report <scenario> <out-prefix> [extra args]
  local s="$1" o="$2"; shift 2
  run python3 -I "$REPORT" --runs "$FX/$s/runs.jsonl" --manifests "$FX/$s/manifests" --suite "$SUITE" \

}
